newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest crime boss shot in gang war - police.
newsitem.headline: Budapest crime boss shot in gang war - police.

text.p: A Budapest gang leader was shot dead at point-blank range on Friday in what Hungarian police believe was part of a gang war that has triggered four bombings in a week.
National police spokesman Laszlo Garamvolgyi said the killing happened on Friday, but gave no details: "A police team is preparing a statement," he said.
But police sources said the man, Jozsef Prisztas, was shot with a 9-mm gun while sitting in his jeep.
The sources said Prisztas, owner of several restaurants, was believed to have been involved in protection rackets, murders and abductions.
Since last Saturday, four grenades have exploded in Budapest in what police said was a struggle between rival criminal gangs for control of lucrative sectors of the Hungarian capital's night life.
